description: Coda (now Superhuman Docs) is a doc and table platform with a REST API and MCP server.
auth_notes: Developer Terms list API keys and access tokens among developer credentials; the exact method for API requests is not shown.
gate_detail: Sources do not say how to obtain API credentials or whether a free plan suffices. A section titled Free and Paid Workspaces exists but its content is not shown. Developer Terms require review of Offerings before release to end users.
api_scope: List and search docs, create and copy docs, share and publish them, discover pages, tables, formulas and controls, and read, insert, upsert, update and delete rows.
mcp_notes: Superhuman Docs runs its own MCP server, described in first-party guides; no URL is given in the sources.
blocker_detail: Credential acquisition, plan requirements and auth method are not shown in the sources; Developer Terms mention review before making Offerings available to end users.

evidence.quote: The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda):
This API uses a base path of https://coda.io/apis/v1 .
you may also want to consider using the Superhuman Docs MCP server .
Superhuman Docs runs an MCP server built on the open Model Context Protocol standard
Before making your Offerings available to End Users, you are required to submit them to us for review as described in the Developer Guidelines
application programming interfaces (“APIs”), API keys, CLIs, sample code, access tokens, software development kits

uncertainties: Exact auth method for the API is only inferred from Developer Terms mentioning API keys.
Free versus paid access to the API is not shown.
Webhooks and sandbox are not covered.
S5 and S6 concern Codapay, a different product, and were ignored.
